summary: Fast test of Feb-2026 batch: meta tags, shop-by-category tiles, leads, sale campaigns, admin extras, hamburger nav, regression. 20/20 backend tests pass. Frontend flows for 3 lead forms + sale page + admin extras + hamburger nav all work. Meta tags (Pinterest p:domain_verify + GA4 G-QYDN365M5N) verified in served HTML. One minor issue: sale-cta button is conditional on kit_bundle so it does not render for campaigns without a kit_bundle (fast-test-50 has none). sale-sticky-cta renders unconditionally.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='sale-cta' button only renders when campaign has a kit_bundle (kit && priceView guard at line 71). For a plain campaign like fast-test-50 (no kit_bundle) the main hero CTA is absent. Only sale-sticky-cta at the bottom is present. The review requirement expects sale-cta always to be visible.

issues: Without a kit_bundle the landing has no prominent CTA between the FLAT 50% OFF headline and the sticky bottom bar; the trust strip appears immediately after the headline. Consider rendering a fallback Shop Now CTA (using discount_percent) when kit_bundle is absent.

A marketing 'Unlock ₹50 off' first-time offer modal appears ~3s after load and overlays the lead-submit button on mobile. This is a UX problem for the lead capture flow — users may abandon. Consider suppressing the first-time offer popup on /partner-with-us, /invest-now, /free-skin-advice.

action_items: Render data-testid='sale-cta' unconditionally on SalePage (fallback when kit_bundle absent) — use discount_percent + featured[0] to build the CTA.
Suppress the first-time-order marketing popup on lead-form pages (/partner-with-us, /invest-now, /free-skin-advice) to avoid overlaying the submit button.
(Optional) Investigate the anti-aging cleanser URL bug on production celestaglow.com — need reproduction steps from user.
critical_code_review_comments: SalePage.js line 71 `{kit && priceView && (...)}` — main CTA is gated on kit_bundle; the review spec requires sale-cta always visible. Split kit-panel from CTA button.
LeadFormPage.js uses react-helmet which emits UNSAFE_componentWillMount warnings in strict mode; consider migrating to react-helmet-async to silence noisy console warnings.

skincare_extras.py `_admin(x_admin_token)` correctly returns 401/403 via the shared verify_admin dep — verified via tests. LeadPayload uses pydantic min_length=10 on phone which yields 422 (not the endpoint's 400); acceptable since both are 4xx auth/validation errors.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (sale-cta missing when no kit_bundle; all other flows PASS)

test_credentials: Admin: X-Admin-Token: celestaglow2024 (also stored to localStorage as adminToken for /admin/extras).
seed_data_creation: Created sale campaign slug='fast-test-50' (Fast Test 50 Off, 50% discount, active). Also seeded partner/invest/skin_concern leads via lead form submission for admin-extras verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend feb-2026 extras APIs (shop-by-category tiles / leads / sale-campaigns) all pass. Regression endpoints /api/concerns, /api/categories, /doctor-consultation, /admin/orders all return 200 in <200ms. Meta tags (Pinterest + GA4) present in index.html. Only functional gap is SalePage sale-cta hidden for campaigns without kit_bundle. Test data leftover: sale campaign 'fast-test-50' still in DB — safe to leave for E1 self-test.
rca of the issue: SalePage sale-cta absent: In /app/frontend/src/pages/SalePage.js the block containing `data-testid='sale-cta'` is wrapped by `{kit && priceView && (...)}` (line 71). `kit` comes from `c.kit_bundle` so unless the admin sets a kit_bundle payload when creating the campaign, the CTA never renders. Fix: either render a fallback CTA outside the kit-price panel, or move the sale-cta button below the headline unconditionally and keep the kit panel independent.
